description:
Music video for the crowdfunded project Plantopia. This original project is a collaboration between LAM, Kukka, and Nozomu Kuoka which spans anime, figures, and a novel series. The first anime of this project is a music video directed by Yuuki Igarashi, and is accompanied by the song Shitsurakuen by Mafumafu.

Note: A short ~1-min narrated version PV was released prior on the TWIN ENGINE YouTube channel on August 5, 2022. The full length music video premiered on Mafumafu's channel on October 15, 2022.
